```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  dev = c("png", "pdf"), dpi = 300
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
})

# print a plot, or a note when its view has no runs (e.g. a narrow run)
show <- function(df, p) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) cat("No runs match this view.") else print(p)
}
```

```{r load-data}
# a pipeline without one of these parameters leaves its column out
with_params <- function(df) {
  for (col in paste0("pipeline_", c("filter", "d_cluster", "n_comp", "n_neig", "n_hvg"))) {
    if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- NA
  }
  df
}

# one row per pipeline run and clustering algorithm; lineage columns from the
# METRIC gather: dataset, pipeline (module id), pipeline_<parameter>
metrics_long <- with_params(params$metrics) %>%
  mutate(
    method = as.factor(pipeline),
    filtering = as.factor(pipeline_filter),
    d_cluster = as.integer(pipeline_d_cluster),
    n_comp = as.integer(pipeline_n_comp),
    n_neig = as.integer(pipeline_n_neig),
    n_hvg = as.integer(pipeline_n_hvg),
    dataset = as.factor(dataset),
    algorithm = as.factor(algorithm),
    n_clusters = as.integer(n_clusters),
    resolution = as.numeric(resolution)
  )

# one row per pipeline run and phase
timings <- with_params(params$timings) %>%
  mutate(
    method = as.factor(pipeline),
    filtering = as.factor(pipeline_filter),
    dataset = as.factor(dataset)
  )

# the older rapids-singlecell build only feeds the version comparison
metrics_long_new <- metrics_long %>% filter(method != "rapids_rsc013")
timings_new <- timings %>% filter(method != "rapids_rsc013")

metrics_long %>% glimpse()
timings %>% glimpse()
```

# ARI vs number of clusters

These curves show ARI as a function of the number of clusters, grouped by method and filtering mode, and faceted by dataset and algorithm.

We only include runs with manual filtering, `n_comp = 50`, `n_neig = 20`, and `n_hvg = 1000`.

```{r ari-curves, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
ari_curves <- metrics_long_new %>%
  filter(
    filtering == "manual",
    n_comp == 50,
    n_neig == 20,
    n_hvg == 1000
  ) %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, filtering, algorithm) %>%
  arrange(n_clusters, .by_group = TRUE)

show(ari_curves, ggplot(
  ari_curves,
  aes(x = n_clusters, y = ari, color = method)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(algorithm ~ dataset, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of clusters",
    y = "ARI",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

# Resolution to cluster count mapping

This view shows how resolution translates to cluster count for each algorithm.

```{r resolution-vs-clusters, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
resolution_map <- metrics_long_new %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, filtering, algorithm, n_clusters) %>%
  summarize(resolution = mean(resolution, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

show(resolution_map, ggplot(
  resolution_map,
  aes(x = resolution, y = n_clusters, color = method, linetype = filtering)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(algorithm ~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Resolution",
    y = "Number of clusters",
    color = "Method",
    linetype = "Filter mode"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

# Robustness: ARI distribution across parameter settings

This shows how stable each method is across parameter choices.

```{r robustness-ari, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
ari_robust <- metrics_long_new %>%
  filter(filtering == "manual")

show(ari_robust, ggplot(
  ari_robust,
  aes(x = method, y = ari, fill = method)
) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.4, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(algorithm ~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Method",
    y = "ARI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ))
```

# Tradeoffs: agreement vs structure

Scatter of ARI (agreement) vs silhouette (structure) to see tradeoffs per method.

```{r tradeoff-ari-silhouette, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
tradeoff_df <- metrics_long_new %>% filter(filtering == "manual")

show(tradeoff_df, ggplot(
  tradeoff_df,
  aes(x = silhouette, y = ari, color = method)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.4) +
  facet_grid(algorithm ~ dataset, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Silhouette",
    y = "ARI",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

## rapids-singlecell version comparison (0.13.5 vs 0.14.1)

```{r rapids-version-comparison, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
rapids_versions <- metrics_long %>%
  filter(
    method %in% c("rapids_rsc014", "rapids_rsc013"),
    filtering == "manual",
    n_comp == 30,
    n_neig == 20,
    n_hvg == 1000
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    version = recode(
      method,
      "rapids_rsc014" = "v0.14.1",
      "rapids_rsc013" = "v0.13.5"
    )
  )

show(rapids_versions, ggplot(
  rapids_versions,
  aes(x = n_clusters, y = ari, color = version)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(algorithm ~ dataset, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of clusters",
    y = "ARI",
    color = "rapids-singlecell version"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

# Timings overview

We restrict to runs done with manual filtering. Each bar is the mean phase
duration recorded by obkit; for `louvain` and `leiden` it is the mean time per
clustering run during the resolution search (phase time / number of runs).

```{r timings-summary, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
timings_summary <- timings_new %>%
  filter(filtering == "manual", !is.na(seconds)) %>%
  mutate(seconds = ifelse(phase %in% c("louvain", "leiden"), per_run_seconds, seconds)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, stage = phase) %>%
  summarize(mean_seconds = mean(seconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

show(timings_summary, ggplot(timings_summary, aes(x = dataset, y = mean_seconds, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~stage, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number()) +
  labs(
    x = "Dataset",
    y = "Mean seconds",
    fill = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)))
```
